modelIntro.title: What Is HappyHorse AI Video Generator?
description: HappyHorse is an Alibaba video model family for text-to-video and image-to-video creation. Toolaze exposes HappyHorse 1.1 and the base HappyHorse model in the same generator so you can choose the version that fits the reference file, aspect ratio, and quality target.

Use it when you need smooth subject motion, clear shot direction, and consistent visual storytelling without building a full editing timeline first. It is especially useful for product motion tests, lifestyle clips, character beats, tactile ASMR scenes, and storyboard drafts.

howToUse.title: How to Use HappyHorse on Toolaze

steps.title: Choose the HappyHorse version
steps.desc: Start with HappyHorse 1.1 for the widest ratio set and a 20MB image limit. Choose the base HappyHorse model when a simpler 10MB reference workflow is enough.

steps.title: Pick text or image input
steps.desc: Use text-to-video for a fresh concept, or upload one reference image when identity, product shape, costume, or scene layout needs to stay recognizable.

steps.title: Set motion, quality, and sound direction
steps.desc: Select 720p or 1080p, choose a supported duration, then describe the camera movement, shot order, subject action, lighting, and native audio cues.

steps.title: Generate, compare, and tighten the prompt
steps.desc: Review the clip for motion drift, reference fidelity, and sound timing. Re-run with a shorter shot list or stronger preservation notes when the result feels too broad.

promptExamples.title: HappyHorse Prompt Examples
promptExamples.subtitle: Use these as practical starting points, then set duration, resolution, and aspect ratio in the Toolaze controls.

items.title: Product Reveal
items.prompt: Create a premium product video for a matte black portable speaker on a stone table. Start with a slow side push, move into a close detail of the fabric grille, then reveal a soft blue light pulsing under the logo. Keep the product shape stable, add gentle bass vibration, room tone, and crisp button clicks.
items.description: Good for product demos that need controlled object consistency and sound cues.

items.title: Reference Character Beat
items.prompt: Animate the uploaded character image into a short dramatic moment. The character turns toward a bright window, coat fabric shifts with the movement, hair reacts to a light breeze, and the camera moves from shoulder detail to a calm face close-up. Preserve facial features, clothing colors, pose language, and background mood.
items.description: Uses one reference image while asking the model to preserve identity and wardrobe.

items.title: ASMR Texture Scene
items.prompt: Create a macro ASMR clip of translucent jelly cubes being pressed with a small metal spoon on a ceramic plate. Show slow compression, tiny surface ripples, droplets catching the light, and the spoon lifting away. Add soft squish sounds, plate contact, tiny taps, and no music.
items.description: Designed for tactile material motion with native audio direction.

items.title: Multi-Shot Lifestyle Ad
items.prompt: Create a lifestyle ad for a lightweight running jacket at sunrise. Shot one shows fabric moving in the wind, shot two follows the runner from the side, and shot three holds on the zipper detail as sunlight hits the reflective strip. Keep the jacket color and logo placement consistent, add footsteps, wind, and city ambience.
items.description: Gives HappyHorse a compact multi-shot sequence with product preservation.

troubleshooting.title: Better HappyHorse Prompt Direction
troubleshooting.subtitle: HappyHorse responds best when the prompt separates the version choice, the preserved subject, the motion path, and the sound layer.

items.title: Make the shot order explicit
items.desc: Weak prompt: Make a fashion clip. Better prompt:
items.prompt: Weak: Make a fashion clip. Better: Create a three-shot fashion clip for a silver jacket. Start with a shoulder detail, cut to a walking side view, then end on a close-up of the sleeve texture. Keep the jacket shape and color consistent, use soft sunrise light, and add fabric rustle plus quiet footsteps.

items.title: Protect the reference image
items.desc: Weak prompt: Animate this image. Better prompt:
items.prompt: Weak: Animate this image. Better: Animate the uploaded portrait with a slow camera push and a subtle head turn. Preserve face shape, hairstyle, jacket color, background layout, and lighting direction while adding natural breathing and light wind.

items.title: Name tactile audio for ASMR
items.desc: Weak prompt: Add ASMR sounds. Better prompt:
items.prompt: Weak: Add ASMR sounds. Better: Create a close macro scene of a soap bar being shaved with a thin blade. Add crisp slicing, tiny flakes landing on ceramic, soft hand movement, and no background music.

faq.q: What is the difference between HappyHorse 1.1 and HappyHorse?
faq.a: HappyHorse 1.1 supports a larger 20MB image reference limit and adds wider ratio coverage including 4:5, 5:4, 9:21, and 21:9. The base HappyHorse model keeps the core ratios and a 10MB image limit, which is enough for simpler reference-led drafts.

Yes. Write the prompt as a short shot sequence with one action per beat, and include what should remain consistent across cuts, such as product shape, outfit color, logo placement, or character identity.

Yes. Add concrete audio cues such as fabric rustle, footstep rhythm, camera-room ambience, blade contact, or soft product sounds. Avoid generic wording like good audio when the sound needs to match the motion.

faq.q: Is HappyHorse suitable for ASMR videos?
faq.a: It can work well for ASMR-style material clips when the prompt names the texture, close camera distance, contact sounds, and no-music preference. It is best for short tactile scenes rather than long continuous ASMR sessions.

faq.q: Can I use a reference image with HappyHorse?
faq.a: Yes. Use image-to-video when you need the person, product, costume, or layout to remain recognizable. HappyHorse accepts one reference image, with the file size limit depending on the selected version.
